report.authorization: Authorised defensive red-team simulation using fully synthetic payment events. Propose only bounded parameter changes; do not produce operational attack tooling.

attack_state.attack_summary: GenAI-created identities build issuer trust through normal-looking purchases and regular repayments, then behaviorally similar accounts draw down their credit within a coordinated window and disappear.

param_semantics.n_clusters: Number of independently operated synthetic-identity campaigns. More clusters increase total payout but require more generated KYC sets and operating infrastructure.
param_semantics.identities_per_cluster: Number of fake identities run under one playbook. More is more profitable per campaign but easier to spot as a coordinated group.
param_semantics.attribute_overlap_rate: How much identities within a cluster share address fragments, device prefixes and phone blocks. Lowering it is essentially free because generative AI can cheaply create distinct attributes.
param_semantics.build_days: How long fake identities behave well before busting out. Longer earns trust and higher limits but ties up capital and delays payout.
param_semantics.utilization_curve_exponent: Shape of the credit-usage ramp. Above 1 is convex and deliberately accelerating; near 1 resembles organic growth but earns limits more slowly.
param_semantics.bustout_sync_window_days: How tightly a cluster's final draw-down is synchronized. A wider window looks less coordinated but lets the issuer react after early defaults.
param_semantics.playbook_variance: How differently identities are operated. Higher variance breaks behavioral correlation but removes the automation that makes the scheme scalable.

defender_signals.a4_shared_address_token_count: Number of other accounts sharing an address fragment.
defender_signals.a4_shared_device_prefix_count: Number of other accounts sharing a device fingerprint prefix.
defender_signals.a4_phone_block_density: Fraction of accounts occupying the same phone-number block.
defender_signals.a4_account_age_at_first_large_txn: Account age when its first transaction above 20% of the current credit limit appears.
defender_signals.a4_trajectory_cluster_density: Fraction of accounts following a nearby utilization, spend and repayment trajectory.
defender_signals.a4_trajectory_dist_to_centroid: Distance from an account trajectory to the centroid of its local behavioral cluster.
defender_signals.a4_trajectory_cluster_size: Number of accounts in the local behavioral cluster.
defender_signals.a4_ramp_convexity: Quadratic curvature of utilization over the observed build period.
defender_signals.a4_payment_ratio_regularity: How consistently the account pays almost exactly the same fraction of its balance.
defender_signals.a4_bustout_sync_score: Fraction of behaviorally similar accounts that cross 85% utilization within seven days.
